name: Cyndi Global Showcase Data
description: showcase.json is the single content source for this project. To add or edit products, update src/data/showcase.json and drop the images into the matching folder under public/images/products/.

meta.title: Page title shown at the top
meta.subtitle: Subtitle
meta.projectName: Project name (heading of the intro block)

categories.id: Unique category id (English, used as the URL anchor)
categories.name: Category name (English)

product.name: Product name
product.gallery: Gallery image URLs (array) — clicking the main image opens the lightbox
product.colors: Colours [{name, hex, image}] — more than 8 collapse behind "... show more"

notes: Image paths start with / and map to the public/ folder, e.g. public/images/products/totes/x.jpg → /images/products/totes/x.jpg
Colour swatches beyond 8 are collapsed automatically and can be expanded with show more
Write prices in ascending quantity order — the front end renders them as a tier table
